data.title: Can Bitcoin Get Back Above $85,000 in November?
data.description: Bitcoin fell just $150 short of $85,000 before sellers took over, and now four price levels, restless ETF flows, spiking oil prices, and a looming election stand between the crypto and a November recovery.
